title: Replacing a phone number on a sealed Joomla site reaches the contact record that holds it too
steps: S1: dry run of a replace with all:true on a sealed Joomla site whose contact record holds the old number.
S3: a replace of words that only the contact record holds.
expect: S1: the dry run lists the contact record with the field that holds the number.
S2: the contact is written through content.update and carries its own undo next to the slots' undo.
S3: the contact is written; the replace does not answer NOT_FOUND.
evidence: Issue #204: on a sealed Joomla site the agent changed the phone number in the modules and the contact page kept the old one

tests: sealed Joomla, all:true: the dry run names the contact record that holds the number too (#204)
sealed Joomla, all:true: the write reaches the contact too, under its own undo (#204)
sealed Joomla, all:true: words only a contact holds are written there, not refused NOT_FOUND (#204)
